content.title: About
content.content: Beef Gravy, Fat Free (1919) is a ready‑to‑use sauce made from beef broth, thickened without added fats. It delivers a rich meaty flavor and aromatic spices while fitting low‑fat dietary plans.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The product was formulated for people who want the taste of beef without the fat.
Ingredients include only beef broth, natural flavorings, spices, and a fat‑free thickener.
Fat‑free gravy is commonly used in diet cooking as a substitute for traditional butter‑based sauces.
It can be heated in a microwave or on the stovetop in 2‑3 minutes.
The lack of fat gives it a longer shelf life compared to regular gravies.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: No added fats make this gravy suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Source of protein
items.content: Beef broth provides a modest amount of protein that helps maintain muscle mass.

items.title: Contains iron
items.content: Beef is a good source of heme iron, which is readily absorbed by the body.

items.title: Low‑calorie
items.content: Calorie content is significantly lower than that of traditional butter‑based gravies.

items.title: No trans fats
items.content: The absence of fats eliminates trans‑fat content, which is beneficial for cardiovascular health.

items.title: Beef allergy
items.content: Some individuals may be allergic to beef or to the spices used in the product.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Like many ready sauces, it can contain a relatively high amount of salt; people with hypertension should monitor portion size.

items.title: Monosodium glutamate
items.content: Flavor enhancers such as MSG may be present, which can cause sensitivity in certain consumers.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Add the gravy to boiled potatoes, vegetables, lean meats, or use it as a base for soups. Heat in a saucepan or microwave, stirring to prevent lumps.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place in the original packaging. After opening, keep refrigerated and use within 5‑7 days. Discard if an off‑odor or discoloration develops.
